limits: No pre-implementation native baseline was captured; these are forward trials.

Earlier failed outputs remain historical. Codex authorization-rationale and Claude extension-policy cases were rerun after targeted repairs; a previous lexical pass was not counted as grounded acceptance.
Checker false negatives for safe nl and sed print ranges were corrected by replaying original events into separate automatic-recheck records, without new model calls or rewriting raw outputs.
Native invocation, source inspection, answer semantics, and absence of effects are separate dimensions. Automatic signals require the recorded manual source judgment.
Each trial is bound to its own copied fixture digest; no claim is made that all fixtures or historical outputs are identical to the final checkout.
Read-only Codex sandbox and restricted Claude tool/permission set are part of the observed security envelope; no claim of security under arbitrary host settings.
Only the recorded macOS, CLI versions, defaults, and cases were observed. Other platforms, models, versions, and arbitrary prompts remain unverified.
Raw native evidence is retained locally under ignored .guide-results and is not packaged or committed.
Issue #1 remains open. Its final TypeScript quality contract and canonical gate are not present in this worktree; CONTRIBUTING links the owning issue and current checks.
